short: First neural transducer for audio-visual speech in the ledger, but its LRS3 gain mixes 31k h of data with the decoder; overlap augmentation is new, one run, one test set: all three standard.
position: M06, M02 and M03 changed, all standard: RNN-T is new in the ledger (0 of 123 earlier sentence-level studies) and still used at 0.9% LRS3 AVSR WER in 2023, but the paper never compares it with CTC or attention on its own 31k-hour corpus; the corpus scales the V2P pipeline; overlapping-speech augmentation is new among 107 earlier AVSR studies but rests on one run and one non-public test set. The LRS3 state-of-the-art claim confounds data volume with the decoder, as the authors concede.
